about: Funding to help Abu Dhabi inventors register patents in the UAE and abroad.
note: Requirements read from the official AD.iP Takamul Patent Support page on the checked date. Details are filled in after sign-in, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

eligibility: Open to Abu Dhabi citizens, and to small and medium companies, academic institutions and other economic establishments licensed in the emirate, with proof of approval to apply for a patent
The idea must be unpublished, new, technical and meant for a product or service
documents: Proof of approval to apply for a patent (companies and institutions)
timing: Eligibility is assessed, possibly with an interview, then the result is sent; grant payment usually starts about a month after approval
